title: Final review of hn6 (watch becomes a dashboard)
description: Review hn6's full epic diff against its description, rules 1-8 and acceptance A1-A6. In particular: one status model, two renderers — the terminal dashboard, bare overview and phone page take every word from ticfac.status.v1 (A5); rule 7 honesty — no path prints $0.00 for unmetered spend; stale claims — grep watch_view.go, watch.go, overview.go, phone.ts and statusmodel doc comments for sentences the rewrite falsified (e.g. 'no keys', 'keep lines above the block', 'only Go reads it today'). A6: J (u4l) proves the layout properties in the gate; the Bombadil-in-CI half is z7w's (outside this epic) — record whether z7w has landed and say so in the verdict rather than holding on it. Fold findings by seam.
